formMetadata.purpose: Used to request an Employment Authorization Document (EAD) to work legally in the United States

Part 1 – Reason for Applying.description: Checkbox: I am applying for permission to accept employment.
Part 1 – Reason for Applying.notes: Select if this is an initial application for employment authorization.

Part 1 – Reason for Applying.description: Checkbox: I am applying for replacement of my lost, stolen, or damaged Employment Authorization Document.
Part 1 – Reason for Applying.notes: Select if replacing an EAD that was lost, stolen, or damaged. Original EAD must have been unexpired.

Part 1 – Reason for Applying.description: Checkbox: I am applying to renew my Employment Authorization Document.
Part 1 – Reason for Applying.notes: Select if renewing an existing EAD before or after it expires.

Part 1 – Reason for Applying.description: Checkbox: My Employment Authorization Document was issued with incorrect information.
Part 1 – Reason for Applying.notes: Select if requesting correction of an EAD issued with errors by USCIS.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 1.a: Applicant's Family Name (Last Name).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your legal family/last name as shown on your passport or other official documents.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 1.b: Applicant's Given Name (First Name).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your legal given/first name as shown on your passport or other official documents.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 1.c: Applicant's Middle Name.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your middle name if applicable. Leave blank if none.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 2.a: Other Names Used - Family Name (Last Name).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter any other family name you have used (maiden name, previous married name, alias).

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 2.b: Other Names Used - Given Name (First Name).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter any other given name you have used.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 2.c: Other Names Used - Middle Name.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter any other middle name you have used.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 3.a: Additional Other Name Used 1 - Family Name.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter additional family name if you have used more than one other name.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 3.b: Additional Other Name Used 1 - Given Name.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter additional given name if you have used more than one other name.

Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter additional middle name if you have used more than one other name.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 3.f: Additional Other Name Used 2 - Middle Name.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter additional middle name if you have used more than two other names.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: USCIS ELIS Account Number (if any).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your USCIS online account number if you have one (12 characters).

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 4.a: U.S. Mailing Address - In Care Of Name.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter 'In Care Of' name if mail should be directed to another person at your address.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 4.b: U.S. Mailing Address - Street Number and Name.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your U.S. street address. USCIS will mail your EAD to this address.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 4.c: U.S. Mailing Address - Unit Type: Apt.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if unit type is Apartment.

Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if unit type is Suite.

Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if unit type is Floor.

Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your apartment, suite, or floor number.

Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter the city or town of your U.S. mailing address.

Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter the two-letter state abbreviation.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 4.f: U.S. Mailing Address - ZIP Code.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter the 5-digit ZIP code (or 9-digit if known).

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 5: Is your current U.S. physical address the same as your U.S. mailing address? - Yes.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select Yes if you live at the same address where you receive mail.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 5: Is your current U.S. physical address the same as your U.S. mailing address? - No.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select No if your physical residence is different from your mailing address. You must provide physical address below.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 6.a: U.S. Physical Address - Street Number and Name.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your physical residence street address. Cannot be a P.O. Box. Required if Line 5 is 'No'.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 6.b: U.S. Physical Address - Unit Type: Apt.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if unit type is Apartment.

Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if unit type is Suite.

Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter apartment, suite, or floor number.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 6.c: U.S. Physical Address - City or Town.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter the city or town of your physical address.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 6.d: U.S. Physical Address - State.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter the two-letter state abbreviation.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 6.e: U.S. Physical Address - ZIP Code.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter the 5-digit ZIP code.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 7: Alien Registration Number (A-Number), if any.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your 9-digit A-Number if you have one. Format: A-XXXXXXXXX.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 8: USCIS Online Account Number, if any.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your USCIS online account number (12 characters) if you have one.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 9: Sex - Male.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if applicant is male.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 9: Sex - Female.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if applicant is female.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 10: Marital Status - Single, Never Married.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if you have never been legally married.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 10: Marital Status - Married.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if you are currently legally married.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 10: Marital Status - Divorced.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if your marriage has been legally dissolved.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 10: Marital Status - Widowed.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select if your spouse has passed away.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 12.a: Have you EVER applied for an Employment Authorization Document (EAD)? - Yes.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select Yes if you have previously applied for an EAD.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 12.a: Have you EVER applied for an Employment Authorization Document (EAD)? - No.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select No if this is your first EAD application.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 12.b: Social Security Number on the Employment Authorization Document.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: If you answered Yes to 12.a, enter the SSN that was printed on your previous EAD.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 13: Do you want the Social Security Administration to issue you a Social Security card? - Yes.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select Yes if you want SSA to automatically issue you an SSN card with your EAD approval.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 13: Do you want the Social Security Administration to issue you a Social Security card? - No.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select No if you already have an SSN or do not want one issued automatically.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 14: Consent to disclose information to SSA? - Yes.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select Yes to authorize USCIS to share your information with SSA for issuing an SSN.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 14: Consent to disclose information to SSA? - No.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select No if you do not consent. Note: If No, SSA cannot issue you an SSN card through this process.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 15.a: Father's Family Name (Last Name).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your father's legal family name.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 15.b: Father's Given Name (First Name).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your father's legal given name.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 16.a: Mother's Family Name (Last Name).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your mother's legal family name (maiden name or current name).

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 16.b: Mother's Given Name (First Name).
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter your mother's legal given name.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 17.a: Father's Country of Birth.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter the country where your father was born.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 17.b: Mother's Country of Birth.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Enter the country where your mother was born.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 19: Eligibility Category checkbox option 1.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select the applicable eligibility category for your EAD application. See form instructions for category codes.

Part 2 – Information About You.description: Line 19: Eligibility Category checkbox option 2.
Part 2 – Information About You.notes: Select the applicable eligibility category for your EAD application.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 24: Current Immigration Status.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 25: Eligibility Category - Section 1 code.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 25: Eligibility Category - Section 2 code.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 25: Eligibility Category - Section 3 code.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 27.a: Applicant's STEM OPT - Field of Study/Degree.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 27.b: Employer's Name (for STEM OPT).
Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.notes: For STEM OPT extension: Enter the name of your E-Verify employer.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 27.c: Employer's E-Verify Company Identification Number.
Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.notes: For STEM OPT extension: Enter the employer's E-Verify ID number.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 28: Receipt Number from a related pending application.
Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.notes: Enter the USCIS receipt number of your pending application that is the basis for this EAD (e.g., I-485 receipt).

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 29: Have you EVER been arrested, cited, charged, or detained by any law enforcement officer? - Yes.
Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.notes: Select Yes if you have ever had any encounter with law enforcement resulting in arrest, citation, charge, or detention.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 29: Have you EVER been arrested, cited, charged, or detained by any law enforcement officer? - No.
Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.notes: Select No if you have never been arrested, cited, charged, or detained.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 30.a: Receipt Number of prior EAD application (if applicable).
Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.notes: Enter the receipt number of your previous EAD application if renewing or replacing.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 30.b: Were you issued an EAD based on that application? - Yes.
Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.notes: Select Yes if you received an EAD from the prior application.

Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.description: Line 30.b: Were you issued an EAD based on that application? - No.
Part 2 – Information About You (Continue.notes: Select No if you did not receive an EAD from the prior application.
